# HX-9 Pilot Line — Weekly Notes (Week 39)

- First-pass production yield for the week closed at 93.5 %, up from last week on fewer tab-weld
  rejects and a steadier coater.
- A line-side energy-density audit on 20 pulled cells averaged 0.272 kWh/kg, consistent with the
  specification sheet once the units are converted.
- The cathode oven set point for the week ran at 1018 K on the pilot kiln; the operator log uses
  kelvin on that controller, so it is recorded here in kelvin.
- Scrap was 2.1 % of starts; the biggest single driver was electrode edge cracking at the
  6.2 mg/cm² loading, with 11 events logged across the week.
- Throughput held at 320 cells per shift across 3 shifts; downtime was 42 minutes for one coater
  purge and a routine slitter blade change.
- Safety: one near-miss from an electrolyte spill and 0 recordable injuries this week. Cells
  continue to ship with the UN 38.3 summary and are acceptance-tested at 25 °C.

Carryover actions: tighten the slitting tolerance to 0.2 mm, and repeat the 1C/1C acceptance on the
next 48-cell lot. The yield and energy-density figures here are internal pilot numbers and should
not be quoted outside the HX-9 program. Nominal cell voltage remains 3.65 V. The next line review
is on Thursday with the program and quality leads.

# Final Research Report: Granted Patents and Vendors Addressing Electrode Edge Cracking at High Areal Loading - HX-9 Pilot Line

**Objective:** Identify granted patents and vendors relevant to electrode edge cracking at the high areal loading regime used on HX-9, using only public patent disclosures.

**Methodology:** Review of 6 query result sets over public patents. No proprietary HX-9 parameters were used in search or disclosed in this report. Proprietary targets such as exact cell energy density, cathode Ni ratio and calcination temperature were intentionally excluded.

## 1. Executive Summary

No result in the provided sets was confirmed on its face as a granted patent specifically claiming prevention / mitigation of coating / calendering **edge** cracking.

Closest technical hits for follow-up full-text review are:

* Crack interface disclosure in collector / active layer
* High areal capacity loading disclosures providing loading context
* Coating uniformity and binder disclosures that are indirectly relevant

Multiple results were screened as out-of-scope for edge cracking.

## 2. Detailed Patent Findings

### 2.1 Directly Relevant - Crack Disclosure

**Lithium ion secondary battery**

> Only result across hops 1-6 with snippet explicitly stating electrode collector and the negative electrode active material layer have a crack [Lithium ion secondary battery].

Assessment:
* Potentially relevant to crack propagation, adhesion, or collector / active layer interface failure.
* Snippet does not confirm whether the disclosure is a mitigation, a detection method, or a failure description, nor does it confirm granted status, edge location, or high-loading applicability.
* Recommendation: Pull full specification, claims, grant status, figures showing crack location - center vs. edge, and examples at high loading / high thickness.

### 2.2 Relevant - High Areal Loading Context

These do not describe an edge-cracking solution in the snippet, but establish public high-loading regimes for comparison without using HX-9 proprietary numbers:

**Anode electrode composition of Li-ion battery cell**

> Discloses an areal capacity loading in the range of about 3 mAh/cm2 [Anode electrode composition of Li-ion battery cell].

**Lithium battery cell including cathode having metal fluoride core-shell particle**

> Discloses a conversion-type metal fluoride comprising cathode [Lithium battery cell including cathode having metal fluoride core-shell particle] and a composite core-shell particle with areal capacity loading that ranges from around 2... [units truncated in snippet] [Lithium battery cell including cathode having metal fluoride core-shell particle].

**Battery electrode composition comprising biomass-derived carbon**

> Repeatedly returned across hops 1-6 as mentioning areal capacity loading of the electrode composition ranges from... [Battery electrode composition comprising biomass-derived carbon] [K, and an areal capacity loading of the electrode composition ranges from... truncated].
> Assessment: Matrix / carbon / binder composition may affect cohesion and cracking in thick electrodes generally, but snippet provides no evidence of edge-crack-specific claims. Requires full-text review.

Caution on loading vs. energy density:

**EV pouch cell energy density roundup 2026**

> Public roundup notes cell packaging, anode chemistry and energy density vary across published designs; patent disclosures describe designs rather than verified product ratings [EV pouch cell energy density roundup 2026].
> Do not treat roundup energy density figures as verified product ratings or as HX-9 targets.

> Discloses ratio of the standard deviation of the areal weight [Separator for nonaqueous electrolyte battery, and nonaqueous electrolyte battery].
> Relevance is indirect only: areal weight uniformity metrics are relevant to coating uniformity investigations that often accompany edge thickening / edge cracking, but no edge-cracking solution is shown in snippet.

> Directed to water-based binders for high voltage cathode materials, such as LMNO spinel [Water-based binder for high voltage cathode material for Li-ion battery].

> Describes a battery cell includes a cathode layer and an anode layer [Pre-cracked anode particles for high-rate charging applications].
> This is intentional particle pre-cracking engineering for high-rate charging, a distinct technical approach from unintentional coating / calendering edge cracking defects. Do not conflate.

> Describes increase the internal impedance of the battery upon mechanical or thermal loading [Mitigating thermal runaway in lithium ion batteries using damage-initiating materials or devices].
> Safety / thermal runaway mitigation, not electrode fabrication edge cracking.

> Directed to Charge (SoC) can be accurately queried, and determining a corresponding relation between... [Active equalization method and system of lithium iron phosphate battery pack].
> BMS / equalization topic, unrelated to edge cracking.

**Nonaqueous electrolyte solution, electrochemical element using same, and 1,2-dioxypropane compound used in same**

> Directed to electrolytic solution capable of improving low-temperature load characteristics after high temperature... [Nonaqueous electrolyte solution, electrochemical element using same, and 1,2-dioxypropane compound used in same].
> Electrolyte low-temperature performance, unrelated to mechanical edge cracking.

## 3. Vendor Assessment

No vendors, assignees, or commercial products were identified in the provided titles / snippets.

No evidence in this set to recommend a vendor for HX-9 edge-cracking mitigation. Vendor mapping will require assignee extraction from full patent front pages and separate commercial coating / binder / calendering equipment
